verdict.rationale: Eqvista is a SaaS equity-management platform, so an interactive API reference is a fair question to ask. The evidence pack never mentions an API, an API reference or runnable examples. It covers only cap table features, migration, valuations and support articles, and the llms.txt probe describes the product without pointing to any API docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
